citations.snippet: Travel insurance: buy travel insurance when you book, so cancellation cover starts early. Read the policy for exclusions, such as pre-existing conditions, adventure activities, alcohol-related incidents and destinations with a high Smartraveller advice level, and carry the insure

Smartraveller advice levels: each destination has one of four advice levels: Exercise normal safety precautions, Exercise a high degree of caution, Reconsider your need to travel, and Do not travel. A higher advice level can affect travel insurance cover, so check the advice leve
